from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseCauseAndTitle(BaseModel):
    """Extracted cause of action and title from one judgment document."""
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The official cause of action (案由) stated in the document")
    document_title: str = Field(description="The full title of the judgment/document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of legal document, e.g. '民事判决书', '行政裁定书'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    case_causes_and_titles: list[CaseCauseAndTitle]
